statement:
∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ),
  Function.Periodic g (2 * π) →
    ∀ (t : ℝ), ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, f x * g (x - (t + 2 * π)) = ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, f x * g (x - t)

integrals.function: fun x => f x * g (x - (t + 2 * π))
fun x => f x * g (x - t)

goal.rhs: ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, f x * g (x - t)
goal.expr: (definite_integral((F_f(i0_) * F_g((i0_ - (x2 + (2 * pi))))), i0_, 0, (2 * pi))) - (definite_integral((F_f(i0_) * F_g((i0_ - x2))), i0_, 0, (2 * pi)))

atoms: ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, f x * g (x - t)

values: fun x => Real.cos x + Real.sin (2 * x)
fun x => Real.cos x + Real.sin (2 * x)
